objectName: ZephyrCoanda Bladeless Tower Fan & HEPA H13 Air Purifier
safetyNotes: Verify the EPDM gasket rings on PRT-01 and PRT-03 are continuous with no gaps so 100% of intake air passes through the HEPA H13 filter media.
Route the 24V blower wires through the sealed cable channel in PRT-04 before tightening the diffuser cone.

steps.title: Prepare Weighted Base Pan & Lower EPDM Gasket
steps.note: Set PRT-01 (Weighted Base Pan) on the workbench, press M3 brass heat-set inserts into the perimeter bosses, and adhere a ring of EPDM foam tape (OTS-06) into the filter seat groove.
steps.description: Set PRT-01 (Weighted Base Pan) on the workbench, press M3 brass heat-set inserts into the perimeter bosses, and adhere a ring of EPDM foam tape (OTS-06) into the filter seat groove.

steps.title: Seat Cylindrical True HEPA H13 Filter Cartridge
steps.note: Lower OTS-02 (Cylindrical True HEPA H13 + Activated Carbon Filter) concentrically onto the EPDM foam seal ring inside PRT-01.
steps.description: Lower OTS-02 (Cylindrical True HEPA H13 + Activated Carbon Filter) concentrically onto the EPDM foam seal ring inside PRT-01.

steps.title: Lock 360° Perforated HEPA Intake Shell onto Base
steps.note: Slide PRT-02 (360° Perforated Intake Shell) over the HEPA cartridge and twist 15° clockwise to engage the bayonet base lock.
steps.description: Slide PRT-02 (360° Perforated Intake Shell) over the HEPA cartridge and twist 15° clockwise to engage the bayonet base lock.

steps.title: Bolt Twist-Lock HEPA Compression Retainer Ring
steps.note: Place PRT-03 (HEPA Compression Retainer) with its underside EPDM seal onto the top rim of PRT-02 and tighten 4× M3×10mm screws to compress the filter seal.
steps.description: Place PRT-03 (HEPA Compression Retainer) with its underside EPDM seal onto the top rim of PRT-02 and tighten 4× M3×10mm screws to compress the filter seal.

steps.title: Mount Acoustic Blower Volute & 24V Centrifugal Blower
steps.note: Wrap the perimeter of OTS-01 (120×32mm 24V Centrifugal Blower) in EPDM damping tape, seat it inside PRT-04 (Acoustic Volute), and bolt PRT-04 to PRT-03.
steps.description: Wrap the perimeter of OTS-01 (120×32mm 24V Centrifugal Blower) in EPDM damping tape, seat it inside PRT-04 (Acoustic Volute), and bolt PRT-04 to PRT-03.

steps.title: Fasten Swirl-Recovery Acoustic Diffuser Cone
steps.note: Align PRT-05 (Acoustic Diffuser Transition Cone) over the blower exhaust port and secure with 4× M3×12mm socket head screws.
steps.description: Align PRT-05 (Acoustic Diffuser Transition Cone) over the blower exhaust port and secure with 4× M3×12mm socket head screws.

steps.title: Install Pressurized Plenum Neck Collar
steps.note: Seat PRT-06 (Plenum Neck Collar) onto the top flange of the diffuser cone so the dual bifurcation ducts face left and right.
steps.description: Seat PRT-06 (Plenum Neck Collar) onto the top flange of the diffuser cone so the dual bifurcation ducts face left and right.

steps.title: Mount Lower Coanda Airfoil Loop Split Ring
steps.note: Press the inlet spigot of PRT-07 (Coanda Airfoil Lower Ring) into the PRT-06 neck collar and lock with 4× M3×10mm screws.
steps.description: Press the inlet spigot of PRT-07 (Coanda Airfoil Lower Ring) into the PRT-06 neck collar and lock with 4× M3×10mm screws.

steps.title: Join Upper Coanda Airfoil Crown & Verify 1.5mm Jet Slit
steps.note: Mate the tongue-and-groove mid-plane flange of PRT-08 (Upper Coanda Crown) onto PRT-07 and fasten the 4 concealed M3 screws.
steps.description: Mate the tongue-and-groove mid-plane flange of PRT-08 (Upper Coanda Crown) onto PRT-07 and fasten the 4 concealed M3 screws.

steps.title: Snap Front PWM Control Bezel, PM2.5 Sensor & 24V PSU
steps.note: Mount the 25kHz PWM Controller (OTS-03) and PM2.5 Sensor (OTS-04) inside PRT-09 (Front Bezel Pod), clip onto the neck collar, and plug in the 24V 3A PSU (OTS-05).
steps.description: Mount the 25kHz PWM Controller (OTS-03) and PM2.5 Sensor (OTS-04) inside PRT-09 (Front Bezel Pod), clip onto the neck collar, and plug in the 24V 3A PSU (OTS-05).
